scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/aem-local-site/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/aem-local-site
  set jcr:title{String} to "AEM Local Site"
end
create service user pdf-service with forced path /home/users/system/aem-local-site

set ACL for pdf-service
  allow jcr:read on /content/dam/aem-local-site
end

set ACL for pdf-service
  allow jcr:read,jcr:write on /content/dam/pdf-folder
end
